machines.title: Session owner
machines.blurb: One owner. Keep-alive while fresh, re-auth when stale, no send before that.

invariants.name: FreshBeforeSend
invariants.text: A message goes out only while the session is fresh.

invariants.name: SignedOutIsIdle
invariants.text: A signed-out session is not sending.

story.label: A send is allowed while fresh.
